title: WTO | 10 things the WTO can do
content:
WTO | 10 things the WTO can do
The world is complex.  The World Trade Organization is complex. This booklet is brief, but it tries to  reflect the complex and dynamic nature of trade and the WTO’s trade rules.
It  highlights benefits of the trading system, but it doesn’t claim that everything  is perfect. Were it a perfect system, there would be no need for further  negotiations and for the system to evolve and reform continually.
Nor does this booklet  claim that everyone agrees about everything in the WTO. That’s one of the most  important reasons for having the system: it’s a forum for countries to thrash  out their differences on trade issues.
, there are a  number of reasons why we’re better off with the system than without it.
cut living costs and  raise living standards
settle disputes and reduce trade tensions
stimulate economic growth and employment
cut the cost of doing business internationally
give  the weak a stronger voice
support  the environment and health
contribute  to peace and stability
be  effective without hitting the headlines
The WTO is its  members. With over 150 members, the WTO  has over 150 views — probably more than that, too.
